Here we perform a sanity check to ensure the simulated fusions are within our simulated fastq files.
The fusion names will be within the headers of the fastq, all prefixed with "ref|", therefore we extract fusion names using this. 
BadRead also simulates false chimeras, so I also need to remove fusions which were turned into false chimeras.
```{bash}
#Identify the fusions spiked in to the fastq files
fastq_directory=/bioinformatics/ryley/Algorithm_Benchmark/Adapter_porechop_trimmed/fastq_files/
cd ${fastq_directory}
zgrep -H '@.*ref' *Spiked*fastq.gz |
awk -F '[ ,:=]+' '{
    for (i=1; i<=NF; i++) {
        printf "%s%s", $i, (i==NF ? ORS : ",")
    }
}' > Spiked_Fusions.csv

grep "chimera" Spiked_Fusions.csv > Spiked_Fusions_with_chimeras.csv
grep -v "chimera" Spiked_Fusions.csv > Spiked_Fusions_no_chimeras.csv
```
Read the file generated containing fusions, and count how many fusions are in each file. We can also see how many supporting reads there are for each fusion
```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
Simulateddatainfo_directory <- "~/LongReadFusionCallerBenchmark/SimulatedData/simulated_data_info/"
Spiked_fusion_file <-  paste0(Simulateddatainfo, "Spiked_Fusions_no_chimeras.csv")
Spiked_Fusions <- read.csv(Spiked_fusion_file, header = FALSE)
colnames(Spiked_Fusions) <- c("simulation", "read_id","gene_info","strand","range","lfdgp","length","ergrg","error_free_length","gr","read_identity")

Spiked_Fusions <- Spiked_Fusions %>% select(c(simulation, read_id, gene_info, strand, range, length, error_free_length, read_identity )) %>%
  mutate(gene_info = gsub("ref\\|", "", gene_info)) %>%
  separate(gene_info, into = c("name1","name2", "name3"), sep = "-", remove = FALSE)%>%
  mutate(depth = case_when(
    grepl("100GB", simulation) ~ "100GB",
    grepl("10GB", simulation) ~ "10GB",
    grepl("1GB", simulation) ~ "1GB" # Keep original value if no match
  ), Sequence_Identity = case_when(
    grepl("95", simulation) ~ "95%",
    grepl("90", simulation) ~ "90%",
    grepl("85", simulation) ~ "85%" # Keep original value if no match
  ))
Spiked_Counts <- unique(Spiked_Fusions[c(1,3,12,13)]) |>
  dplyr::count(simulation, depth, Sequence_Identity, name = "Spiked_Number")
Spiked_ReadCounts <- Spiked_Fusions[c(1,3,12,13)] |>
  dplyr::count(simulation, gene_info, depth, Sequence_Identity, name = "Spiked_ReadSupp")
write_csv(Spiked_ReadCounts, file = paste0(Simulateddatainfo_directory, "Fusion_ReadCounts.csv"))

#the numbers above include our self-fusions which were excluded from analysis, so we will filter them out here and recount
Spiked_Counts_wo_SF <- unique(filter(Spiked_Fusions, name1 != name2)[c(1,3,12,13)]) |>
  dplyr::count(simulation, depth, Sequence_Identity, name = "Spiked_Number")
Spiked_ReadCounts_wo_SF <- filter(Spiked_Fusions, name1 != name2) |> #filter out self fusions
  dplyr::count(simulation, gene_info, depth, Sequence_Identity, name = "Spiked_ReadSupp")

```
